verses.8:57: فَإِمَّا تَثۡقَفَنَّهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡحَرۡبِ فَشَرِّدۡ بِهِم مَّنۡ خَلۡفَهُمۡ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَذَّكَّرُونَ

meaning: The root شرد (shrd) describes something that is wild, untamed, or runs away. It can refer to a camel that takes fright and flees, or a horse that is refractory.
